note: The documents the library can search, as data. Adding one is an edit here and a file in data/raw/approval-packages - never a code change. `path: null` means the entry has no source document at all, which is a different fact from a document that failed to read; both end as not-askable with a stated reason, decided in services/api/library.ts. Every FDA entry is a multi-disciplinary review fetched from accessdata.fda.gov by the NDA number in its filename and screened with data/prep/measure_pdf.py before being listed. The set varies on purpose - a boxed hepatotoxicity warning, liver findings without one, approved drugs with no liver warning at all, and a 505(b)(2) with no nonclinical studies - because a set of only hepatotoxic drugs measures willingness to say danger and nothing else.
